# teltonika_rms_email_configuration (Resource)

SMTP email configuration used by RMS alerting (`/email-configurations`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teltonika_rms_email_configuration" "ops_smtp" {
  name     = "ops-smtp"
  host     = "smtp.example.com"
  port     = 587
  email    = "alerts@example.com"
  username = "alerts@example.com"
  password = var.smtp_password
}

variable "smtp_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password. Never surfaced by the RMS API on read; the value is kept in state as-configured.
- `port` (Number)
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)
